To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the finer powders provide better mechanical performance, the Al 9 Si alloy powder composite exhibits a low compressive strength due to the presence of brittle Si particles and the Al 4 5Si 2 5Cu alloy composites present the best specific strengths.
the sintering behavior and mechanical properties are affected by the powder particle size and morphology and by the solute content of the powder particles.
the Al 5 Cu powder composite is the most promising material for sintering process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of the size and shape of recycled as cast powders from Al alloys.
the evaluation of the effects of the particle morphology and size on the densification and mechanical response of recycled Al casting alloys powders.
the development of a new recycling technology for the production of high quality powder composites from Al 9Sialloy scrap.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the finer powder particles and the Al Cu alloy composite provide the best mechanical behavior.
the Al 5 Cu alloy composite is the most interesting material for the production of recycled powder metallurgical components.
the sintering process of the examined powders provides a promising and effective way for the recycling of the as cast Al Si, Al Cu alloys.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
finer powders are more suitable for powder metallurgy processing, and the Al Si and AlCu alloy powders are good candidates for the fabrication of metal matrix composites.
the Al 5 Cu alloy powder composite is a good candidate for a low cost material for structural applications.
the sintering of the recycled Al Si and Al 5Cu as cast powders is a feasible and promising route to obtain composites for structural applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is necessary to consider the morphology and size effects of recycled powder particles in the sintered composites, in order to obtain a more effective use of these materials.

the Al 5 Cu composite is a promising material with the best mechanical properties and a good specific strength, making this alloy powder a potential candidate for applications such as the automotive and aerospace sectors.
the Al 5Si 2Cu composite is the most promising for further research and development of new materials from recycled as cast alloys.
